description: Build a dependency license and attribution inventory for a repository: normalize each dependency license, group counts by license, produce attribution lines, and flag unknown licenses, strong-copyleft conflicts with the repository license, weak-copyleft notices, and unclassified licenses.

license.description: SPDX id of the dependency license (optional; missing or empty means unknown)

repo_license.description: SPDX id of the repository's own license, e.g. MIT

name: catalog_licenses
